study: WP-17 S6 T-01: RQP byte study

method.sizes: raw = bytes of the body; gzip and br = Node.js zlib defaults on the decoded body (the method of examples/server-demo/scripts/measure.js)
method.manifest_raw: exact and additive: each byte of the manifest element in one row
method.marginal: size(F or D) - size(F or D without the component); not additive
method.headers: request_http1/response_http1 = name ": " value CRLF of the non-pseudo fields; *_hpack = HPACK header block bytes that Node.js nghttp2 writes on a new HTTP/2 connection
